whatCanWeDo.title: What can we do for you
whatCanWeDo.description: MACEE fills vacancies on behalf of our clients in all areas. Either temporary positions on a project basis, interim roles or internal permanent positions. Here is a brief overview of the contract forms we support:

services.title: Freelance / ZZP
services.description: Temporary projects suitable for self-employed Freelancers (ZZP), working with different clients and without any form of employment with their customer. As a Freelancer (ZZP) you determine your own rate, working hours and working method. These are often specific project positions that require your unique expertise and for which you are paid per hour or per (half) day.

services.title: Contracting / Secondment
services.description: Working on a temporary position, project or interim role whereby you will be employed on the payroll of MACEE. Due to the increasing legal restrictions in hiring external talent, the interim roles considered suitable for a Freelancer (ZZP) are restricted. Leading to an increased need for the ‘Payroll Solution’ that MACEE offers.

services.title: Outsourcing
services.description: Outsourcing work to an external party on a temporary contract basis, whereby the external party performs the work with its own staff and under its own management and is responsible for the result, instead of taking on a permanent employee. It is used for temporary projects, specialist knowledge or to respond flexibly to needs, without the obligations of permanent employment.

services.title: Permanent
services.description: Additionally MACEE also actively assists clients with the ‘Search and Selection’ of candidates for their internal permanent positions.

services.title: HSM / Expats / Visa Sponsorship
services.description: Having found your new temporary contract or project, MACEE will arrange your VISA / Work permit application as we are an official IND (Immigration Service) Recognised Sponsor. Holding this IND registration enables MACEE to relocate highly skilled migrants (HSM Expats) to the Netherlands via a fast and streamlined procedure, making life easier for you.

items.text: The Fintech industry is where technology and finance converge to shape the future of money. From smart payment solutions to innovative platforms, our Fintech clients move quickly, think ahead and dare to innovate. MACEE supports them with professionals who are just as agile and innovative as the industry itself. MACEE has extensive experience in the finance sector, working with Banks, Investment and Asset Management, Pension funds, Payment Platforms and other Fintech companies.

items.name: High Tech Industry

items.text: The Netherlands is a global player in the high-tech industry. Regions such as Eindhoven and Delft are hubs for innovation, precision and technology. As a secondment agency, we work closely with progressive organisations in these high-tech hotspots. Every day, our professionals contribute to groundbreaking solutions with a global impact. This puts us at the heart of the Dutch high-tech engine — where the future is being built.

items.name: Oil & Gas
items.imgDesc: Real-time telemetry, IoT, cloud analytics, and energy transition monitoring.
items.text: The Dutch oil and gas industry, led by key players such as Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij and Shell and supported by strategic infrastructure like the Port of Rotterdam, remains a vital energy hub while undergoing rapid digital transformation. Advanced ICT solutions—ranging from real-time data analytics and cloud computing to cybersecurity and sustainability monitoring—are essential to ensure safe, efficient, and future-proof operations in an evolving energy landscape.
